item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your evening's already built for it — wind-down time, relaxation practice, and a fixed lights-out. That structure only works if you protect it: no scrolling, no "just one more thing" once the wind-down starts. The hour before bed sets the whole night. Action: when your wind-down time hits, phone goes down and stays down.
